title: HistoryResponse
description: Replay response containing a bounded sequence range of stream envelopes from durable outbox history. Used by consumers to catch up across detected sequence gaps or after backpressure lag notifications.

epoch.description: Outbox epoch of the replayed entries.

from_seq.description: Starting sequence watermark of the range (inclusive).

to_seq.description: Ending sequence watermark of the range (inclusive).

entries.description: Ordered list of stream envelopes within the requested sequence range [from_seq, to_seq].
